headline: Submits high school consolidation application to state; moves $1.18 million from special education salaries to contracted services.
summary: The meeting covered mold testing at Reiche, facilities needs, and the middle school design study. The finance committee approved moving $1.18 million from special education salaries to contracted services. The board approved submitting a high school consolidation application to the state.
decisions: Approved moving $1.18 million from special education salaries to contracted services, as a finance committee action.
Approved submitting the school consolidation application to the State Department of Education.
discussion: Reiche mold: Members asked about the testing and building inspections. The superintendent said air and surface tests did not show a mold problem. Mitigation is set for Saturday, October 31st, and Sunday, November 1st, with retesting on Monday.

Middle school design: Members asked for more cost and staffing information on the two-school and three-school options. Staff said a final choice is not due until November 10th, and the board will give guidance then.
Special education staffing: A public speaker said staffing shortages at Deering High School need a clearer account of how the special education money is spent.
Animals in schools policy: The policy committee said the proposed policy would cover animal visits to schools and is not about religion or dogs.
